## HERPES WHITLOW (DIGIT OR HAND CELLULITIS)
## Treatment
## Inpatient

Acyclovir 400 mg PO q8h for 10 days ($) [R]
## Outpatient

Alternative for easier compliance schedule
Valacyclovir 1 gm PO q12h for 10 days ($) [R]
## Acyclovir 400 mg PO TID for 10 days ($) [R]
Non-VA order for above
## Alternative for easier compliance schedule
Valacyclovir 1 gm PO BID for 10 days ($) [R]
Non-VA order for above
References:
Mandell chapter: Herpes simplex virus
Sanford keyword: Whitlow, herpetic
